name: comments_anchors_documents_sequences
description: Merges YAML while preserving destination comments, blank lines, anchors, aliases, document separators, sequences, mappings, scalars, and template-only keys.

ruby_tslp.reason: Ruby TSLP YAML substrate currently drops comments, anchor sigils, and document separators for this fixture.

root: &defaults

  retries: 3
services:

    <<: *defaults
    ports: [3000, 3001]
    labels:
      - template
      - api
---
notes:
  - template
destination:
